# Skip Link

The first focusable thing on the page, and a target that accepts focus.

In `library/components/skip-link/` — copy `component.{html,css}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the target** — `tabindex=-1`
- **a list of destinations** — `aria-label`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — it has to be the first stop — nothing focusable may precede it
- `Enter` — follows it; the ring on the target is the only confirmation of the jump

**States:** clipped, focused, always visible

## Goes wrong when

- display:none to hide it, which makes it unfocusable — the most common broken skip link there is
- :focus-visible instead of :focus, so a programmatic focus leaves it invisible
- no tabindex=-1 on the target, so the page scrolls and the next Tab resumes at the top
- a border in the clipped state, which border-box cannot shrink below: a 1px box becomes 4px
- no white-space:nowrap, so the text wraps inside 1px and is read a letter at a time
- a cookie banner focusable before it

WCAG 2.4.1 2.4.7 2.4.11 2.5.8 4.1.2 · see also `jump-nav`, `focus-ring`, `visually-hidden`
